'''Xivhkalrainik's great-great grandfather''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] living long before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the Kaleesh clan wars he and two of his [[Marriage/Legends|wives]] led an outnumbered force to victory. In Kaleesh culture such exceptional deeds meant the Kaleesh would ascend to godhood after their [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] after their deaths, the [[Xivhkalrainik's family|family]] of their descendants, including [[Xivhkalrainik]], still prayed at their shrines.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xivhkalrainik's great-great grandfather is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Xalek companion storyline.<ref name="SWTOR" />
